env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go build -o $WORK/check$GOEXE check.go
cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exec $WORK/check$GOEXE out/main.go
stdout '^json no synchronization ok$'

-- check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/scanner"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, os.Args[1], data, 0)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	forbidden := map[string]bool{"sync": true, "atomic": true, "mutex": true, "rwmutex": true, "lock": true, "unlock": true, "rlock": true, "runlock": true}
	for _, imp := range f.Imports {
		path, err := strconv.Unquote(imp.Path.Value)
		if err != nil { panic(err) }
		if path == "sync" || path == "sync/atomic" {
			alias := path[strings.LastIndex(path, "/")+1:]
			if imp.Name != nil { alias = imp.Name.Name }
			forbidden[strings.ToLower(alias)] = true
		}
	}
	locals := map[string]*ast.FuncDecl{}
	var queue []*ast.FuncDecl
	seen := map[*ast.FuncDecl]bool{}
	roots := map[string]bool{}
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok { continue }
		if fn.Recv == nil { locals[fn.Name.Name] = fn }
		if fn.Name.Name == "MarshalJSON" && fn.Recv != nil {
			r, ok := fn.Recv.List[0].Type.(*ast.Ident)
			if ok && (r.Name == "Ordinary" || r.Name == "Stateful") {
				roots[r.Name] = true
				queue = append(queue, fn)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(roots) != 2 { panic("missing MarshalJSON roots") }
	walk := false
	for len(queue) != 0 {
		fn := queue[0]
		queue = queue[1:]
		if seen[fn] { continue }
		seen[fn] = true
		body := data[fs.PositionFor(fn.Body.Pos(), false).Offset:fs.PositionFor(fn.Body.End(), false).Offset]
		var scan scanner.Scanner
		scan.Init(token.NewFileSet().AddFile("body", -1, len(body)), body, nil, 0)
		for {
			_, tok, lit := scan.Scan()
			if tok == token.EOF { break }
			if tok == token.CHAN || tok == token.ARROW || tok == token.GO || tok == token.SELECT || tok == token.IDENT && forbidden[strings.ToLower(lit)] {
				panic("synchronization token: " + tok.String() + " " + lit)
			}
		}
		ast.Inspect(fn.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			if s, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && s.Sel.Name == "Walk" { walk = true }
			if call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
				if id, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.Ident); ok && locals[id.Name] != nil { queue = append(queue, locals[id.Name]) }
			}
			return true
		})
	}
	if !walk { panic("missing stateful Walk") }
	fmt.Println("json no synchronization ok")
}

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nosync

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

type Ordinary struct {
	N int64 `json:"n"`
}

type Stateful struct {
	Items []Ordinary `json:"items"`
}

func main() {}
